title: Bug: Objectives Resetting Version 3.3.3.0-dev-c
body:
Upon updating to version 3.3.3.0-dev-c the objectives reset back to objective 1, importing settings does not help.
Also, aaps keeps bringing up tidepool (opening a web link to the tidepool sign in page) every several minutes, probably a feature but still annoying that it does so automatically.
Also, time since last reading displayed in seconds.

comments.body:
to prevent tidepool login disable tidepool plugin
regarding import, you can send me the config with password
OK. it happened to me too.
